import subprocess, threading, http.server, socketserver, time, os

os.chdir(r'C:\Users\User\OneDrive\Desktop\CarVault project')

os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

class QuietHandler(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, format, *args): pass

with socketserver.TCPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), QuietHandler) as httpd:
    port = httpd.server_address[1]
    t = threading.Thread(target=httpd.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    t.start()
    chrome = r'C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe'
    shots = [
        ('home_full.png', f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}/index.html', '1440,2200'),

        ('mobile_home.png', f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}/index.html', '390,900'),
    ]
    for name, url, size in shots:
        dest = os.path.join(out_dir, name)
        subprocess.run([chrome, '--headless=new', '--disable-gpu', f'--window-size={size}', '--hide-scrollbars', f'--screenshot={dest}', url], check=True)
        print('Captured', dest)
